name: vsphere-triage
description: vSphere VM incident triage: read-only MCP server plus the vm-incident diagnosis skill

username.title: vCenter username
username.description: A read-only service account (shared across vCenters unless overridden per-vCenter in the JSON)

password.title: vCenter password
password.description: Stored in the OS secure credential store

index_url.title: Python package index
index_url.description: Where uvx fetches vsphere-triage from. Leave as public PyPI for internet-connected installs; set to an internal PyPI mirror for air-gapped installs.

ca_bundle.title: CA bundle path (optional)
ca_bundle.description: VSPHERE_CA_BUNDLE: a PEM bundle for an internal CA; leave blank to use the system trust store
